body: 150-name Indian validation: S3 fired on 65/128 names and drove 33 of 37 S5 reds (working-capital bank lines; liquid funds in Investments). India S5 = ≥2 of S1 (negative net worth), S2 (interest cover <1.5x), S4 (dividends > FCF while debt rose). Revisit with a survivorship-free Indian test.
title: India solvency S5 excludes S3 (short-term funding gap) until an Indian re-test
